paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupiha,
heading: Giahphual A Namte Tendan
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: “Israel suante’n a inkuan chiamtehna uh bang chiat in apawl uh hihdan bang in apuanin uh akai ding uhi. Kihoupihna puanin a pan bangtan hiam kihal in akai ding uhi.
english: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses: at a distance from the Tent of Meeting shall they encamp around it.”

paite: "Nisuahna lam suahlam pang ah apawl uh tamdan dungzui zel a puanin kai dingte Judah pawlte ahi ding ua; Judah tate lak a vaihawmbmakai ding Amminadab tapa Nashon ahi.
heading: Suahlam Ah
english: Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

paite: Sim a om pawlte tamdan, singsagih sangli-le-zaguk ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

paite: Amah zom a puanin kai dingte Issakar chi ahi ding a; Issakar tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Zuar tapa Nethaneel ahi.
english: Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and the prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

paite: Sim a om pawlte tamdan singnga sangli-le-zali ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

paite: Zebulun chite, Zebulun tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Helon tapa Eliab ahi.
english: The tribe of Zebulun: and the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singnga sangsagih-le-zali ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

paite: Apawl uh tamdan bang zel in sim a om Judah inkuante nuaikhat singgiat sangguk-le-zali ahi uh. Amaute'n ma akai zel ding uhi.
english: All who were numbered of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.

paite: "Apawl uh tamdan bang zel in asimlam pang ah Reubente pawl a-om ding ua; Reuben tate lak a vaihawm makai Shedeur tapa Elizur ahi.
heading: Simlam Ah
english: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli sangguk-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

paite: Azom a dingte Simeon chi ahi ding ua; Simeon tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Zurishaddai tapa Selumiel ahi.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singnga sangkua-le-zathum ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

paite: Huai khit in Gad chite ahi ding ua, Gad tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Reuel tapa Eliasaph ahi.
english: “The tribe of Gad: and the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli sangnga zaguk-le-sawmnga ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

paite: Reubente tamdan nuaikhat singnga sangkhat zali-le-sawmnga ahi uh; apawl uh dungzui in. Azom in amaute apawtkhe ding uhi.
english: “All who were numbered of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.

paite: "Kihoupihna puanin ah akipankhe ding ua, Levite alai ah a-om ding ua, a-omna thu zil bang zel in apawlpawl in apai chiat ding uhi.
heading: Mun Lai Ah
english: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.

paite: "Apawl tamdan thu in atumlam pang ah Ephraimte a-om ding ua, Ephraim tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Ammihud tapa Elishama ahi.
heading: Tumlam Ah
english: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

paite: Azom in Manasseh chi ahi ding a; Manasseh tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Pedazur tapa Gamaliel ahi.
english: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singthum sangnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

paite: Azom nawn in Benjamin chite, Benjamin tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Gideoni tapa Abidan ahi.
english: “The tribe of Benjamin: and the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singthum sangnga-le-zali ahi uh.
english: His army, and those who were numbered of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

paite: Ephraimte tamdan nuaikhat sanggiat-le-zakhat ahi. Azom nawn in apaikhe ding uhi.
english: “All who were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

paite: "Apawl uh tamdan bang zel in Dante amallam pang ah a-om ding ua; Dan tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer ahi.
heading: Mallam Ah
english: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singguk leh sangnih leh zasagih ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

paite: Azom a puanin kai dingte Asher chi ahi ding a; Asher tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Okran tapa Pagiel ahi.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli leh sangkhat leh zanga ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were forty-one thousand and five hundred.

paite: Azom nawn in Naphtali chite; Naphtali tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Enan tapa Ahira ahi,
english: “The tribe of Naphtali: and the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singnga sangthum-le-zali ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

paite: Dante tamdan nuaikhat singnga sangsagih-le-zaguk ahi ua; amau apawlpawl a pawtkhia in ananungpen ahi ding uhi."
english: “All who were numbered of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

paite: Hiai Israel suante inkuan teng a mi asimte uh, tamdan ahi a, nuaiguk sangthum zanga-le-sawmnga apha uhi.
heading: Mipi Gawmkhawm
english: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were numbered of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

paite: Levite Israel suante lak a simtel ahi kei uh; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in.
english: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huchibang in Israel suante'n ahih ua; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang zel in apawlpawl in puanin akai uhi. Huchi mah bang in achichi in a-inkuankuan zel un akipankhe zel uhi.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.
